name.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴
name.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling

caption.ja: 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
caption.en: Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath. Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

name.en: Two-state electronic-angle/nuclear BO and CP-type model

formula: V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear}

note.ja: 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
note.en: Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
equation_note.en: Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

title.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴
title.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling

references.formula: H(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}I+\begin{pmatrix}-\Delta&gQ\\gQ&\Delta\end{pmatrix},\quad\psi=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^T;\quad E(Q,\theta)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\Delta\cos(2\theta)+gQ\sin(2\theta),\quad E_-(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\sqrt{\Delta^2+g^2Q^2};\quad M\ddot Q=-kQ-g\sin(2\theta),\quad\mu\ddot\theta=-2\Delta\sin(2\theta)-2gQ\cos(2\theta);\quad V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear}

assumptions.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
assumptions.en: Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

note.ja: 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
note.en: Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

reference_note.ja: 解析勾配、4096/8192段の固定RK4感度、拡張エネルギーとOU条件付き分散を照合します。
reference_note.en: Check energy gradients, fixed4096/8192 RK4 sensitivity, extended energy, OU heat bookkeeping and conditional temperature variance.

method_note.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
method_note.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.
